name: Feeds
tagline: Reads RSS, Atom and Gemini feeds

offers.label: Start reading here
offers.description: Gives the person a reading of their own here, if they have none yet: the place they read in

offers.label: Add subscription
offers.description: Subscribes to a feed's address, or shows the subscription this library already has.

offers.label: New folder
offers.description: Starts a folder that keeps related subscriptions together; its subscriptions stay when it

offers.label: Mark all as read
offers.description: Marks everything the place `place` lists as read.

offers.label: Refresh all feeds
offers.description: Reads every subscription again. The device fetches them away from the frame, and the app takes

offers.label: Stop refreshing
offers.description: Stops a refresh that is running.

offers.label: Export OPML
offers.description: The library's subscriptions as an OPML 2.0 file. The system's one Export… lists it and saves
